evidence_scope: Controlled synthetic tests only; no independent physical validation.

white_noise_screen.scope: Small deterministic abstention check, not a false-alarm guarantee.

aliasing.explanation: 52Hz and 8Hz are indistinguishable at these sample times. Correct acquisition is mandatory.

estimate.resonance_assumptions: Conditional force-to-displacement SDOF model; excitation and resonance are not experimentally verified.
estimate.assumptions: User-declared free ringdown; isolated linear mode; no forcing.

anomaly.scope: Controlled synthetic displacement-waveform experiment only; no physical fault/diagnostic validation.
limitations: Reference distribution authored for this target, not generic machinery.
Threshold set on independent calibration signals; test untouched.
Input here is synthetic displacement, not camera image. Image-to-signal errors are tested separately.
Outside-reference means statistical novelty, not damage or defect identification.

anomaly_image_check.scope: Small end-to-end simulated-image transfer check; reference threshold unchanged from waveform calibration.

records.reference_scope: Synthetic 7.3Hz target reference, 60fps, 240samples, pixels; not real equipment.
records.explanation: Distance from reference recordings; outside-reference does not imply damage or identify a fault. Setup match is unverified.

anomaly_image_check.note: Only frequency/amplitude changes included; no claim of general anomaly reliability. Different image noise can shift the reference distribution.

protocol.dc_alignment: Estimate and truth each centered once per clip; no fitted gain correction.
protocol.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap over texture-seed cluster means (2000 replicates); repeats at different noise/axes stay in the same cluster. Only three texture seeds per family: exploratory, not instrument calibration.
protocol.method_notes: Phase is an original quadrature-band estimator, not the complete Wadhwa pyramid algorithm. Ablation uses the MLP middle-scale physical estimate without correction.
protocol.timing: Per-frame estimator CPU only; excludes image generation, video IO, stabilization, enhancement, plotting and warmup. Not end-to-end throughput.

refresh_protocol: Image estimates and reference-screening results retained; spectral metrics, failure cases, aggregates and figure regenerated. Ablation diagnostics recomputed from exact seeded inputs with displacement equality asserted, and its timings refreshed. Estimator/checkpoint/reference hashes required to match.
